environment.description: Same Spring Boot 3.1 application deployed on hardened Kubernetes pod (GKE Autopilot). Pod runs with a custom AppArmor profile 'grpc-bridge-confined' loaded via annotation container.apparmor.security.beta.kubernetes.io/grpc-bridge=localhost/grpc-bridge-confined. The profile specifies: deny /** w (global write deny), then selectively allows: /var/log/grpc-bridge/audit.log w (owner match), /tmp/** rw. Additionally, the pod securityContext sets readOnlyRootFilesystem: true with an emptyDir volume mounted exclusively at /var/log/grpc-bridge/. The combination means file write syscalls to any path outside /var/log/grpc-bridge/ are denied at kernel level by the AppArmor LSM hook before reaching the filesystem layer, returning EACCES regardless of DAC permissions.

config.apparmor_rules: profile grpc-bridge-confined flags=(attach_disconnected) { #include <abstractions/base> deny /** w, /var/log/grpc-bridge/audit.log w, /tmp/** rw, /proc/*/fd/ r, network tcp, }
